use_case_summary: Primary pilot: replace heuristics with ML-driven abstractive ticket+email summarization and multi-label auto-tagging integrated into Zendesk macros and Freshdesk workflows. Secondary: agent assist snippets, suggested macros, and tool-calling (create incident, escalate) via webhook/tool-calling support.
technical_requirements: Throughput: baseline 250 req/s; target burst handling to 1k req/s for marketing spikes
Latency: interactive agent assist target p50 < 500ms, p95 < 1200ms
Model behavior: deterministic short summaries (1 sentence TL;DR) + 3 bullet points; confidence score per tag
Routing: prefer low-latency instances in NA region; fallback to quantized cheaper variants during sustained spikes
Integrations: Zendesk middleware (app + webhook), Freshdesk workflows, Slack notifications, internal queueing system
Data controls: opt-in retention for raw text, KMS-managed keys, ability to opt for on-prem/private control plane for regulated customers
Observability: per-request token and latency breakdown, per-tag accuracy tracking, regression alerts tied to golden prompt set
poc_results_summary: POC quality: summaries above baseline heuristics (qualitative thumbs-up from support leads). Tagging precision ~78% on sampled set. Performance issues under synthetic burst tests: hosted baseline exceeded p50 target (1.2s). Next iteration: test Dedicated pool + batching and prefix KV caching; evaluate aggressive quantized model for fallback. Security: SOC2 doc accepted; need KMS integration and explicit data residency clause for EU customers.
